body.purpose: List individual sale records enriched with book details and calendar fields.
when_to_use: List individual sale records enriched with book details and calendar fields.
when_not_to_use: Use get_sales_trends for grouped totals or charts. Revenue and vendor attribution are not available in the fixture.

rules: These are SALE date bounds; both provided or neither; start included, end excluded.
Use known book IDs; filters combine with AND; IDs inside the list are OR.
Filter per-sale quantities; minimum must not exceed maximum.
Page size is 1–50; only continue with the returned cursor for the same filters and limit.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
